body mass index (BMI)—weight in kilograms 
divided by height in meters squared (BMI  kg

with estimates of body composition derived
from skinfold measurements and underwater
weighing (hydrodensitometry), and can easily 
be calculated from weight and height; it is also
known as Quetelet’s index, named after its
developer, Adolphe Quetelet (1796–1874), a
Belgian statistician, astronomer, mathematician,
